what: The text clock ”Place 03:00 AM” in the hero photo corner — it attaches, appears on the first tick 1 second later, rewrites the time every 1 second, and each time only the colon shows and hides (visibility). 12-hour two digits (03) with AM·PM

options.tz: That city’s current time (IANA name, like Asia/Tokyo) — if omitted, the viewer’s local time (as in the original)
options.wait: Time to the first tick (s), default same as every — 0 means characters appear as soon as it attaches
options.blink: If off, the colon does not blink (turns off automatically with the reduced motion setting)

use: City 00:00 AM
